Remove the analog side: the game is about digital circuits now

Wish of the player: take the analog part out completely. Gone are the
analog simulation (nodal analysis, device models), the analog parts
(sources, resistors, capacitors, coils, diodes, LEDs, transistors,
MOSFETs, op-amps, switches, lamps, meters, probe, net names), chapters
4-7 with their 20 levels, the analog examples, the oscilloscope, value
and current display, sparks and smoke, five achievements and the
translations only they used. The simulator is pure logic.

The remaining chapters are numbered 1-8 (56 levels); the lexicon's
basic terms are digital now (bits, hex, edges, bus, ASCII); progress
files drop stars, circuits and achievements that no longer exist; the
menu background, store art, docs and Steam texts follow.
